messages:
tom: FYI during the 3.12.1 rollout I noticed a tranche of EU pushes quarantined by registry with 409 errors. Looks like signing key mismatch again.
anya: which job?
tom: publish-batch-804, kicked off at 2024-11-19T09:48:31Z.
ci-bot: publish-batch-804 started by @tom
deploybot: publish-batch-804: 8/25 success, 17/25 quarantined. Error: MANIFEST_CONFLICT (409). Existing signer=kms-eu-03, incoming signer=kms-eu-04.
luca: we rotated eu KMS late last night 50UTC; some mirrors may still be signed with old key.
tom: log snippet: ```
PUT /v2/redwood/console/manifests/sha256:abcd1234 409 Conflict
existing: signed_by=kms-eu-03 created_at=2024-11-19T02:10:04Z
incoming: signing_time=2024-11-19T09:48:30Z key_id=projects/redwood/kms/eu-04
```
anya: are image pulls failing for customers?
tom: no customer-facing failures yet. Canary saw mixed images in EU canary group. Prod promotion still pending for several services.
luca: short options: (A) re-sign quarantined manifests with eu-04 and push (creates new manifest digests), (B) pin release tag back to stable digest and pause rollout, (C) ask mirror service to backfill resigns then re-run publish.
anya: I'd prefer pin+pause to minimize churn. We can trigger resign-republish as a follow-up.
deploybot: autopause rules matched: critical-manifest-conflict -> release autopause engaged.
ci-bot: publish-batch-804 logs: s3://releases/logs/publish-batch-804/
tom: I'll run the pinback. Which digest to pin to? last stable is 3.12.0@sha256:prev999.
anya: pin to prev999 and add a short note in release tracker. Also include rollback criteria: if canary CPU or error rate >1% revert to prev999 cluster images.
luca: ops-bot any ETA for mirror catch-up?
ops-bot: mirror reconciliation currently 60% complete. Estimated additional 30 minutes.
anya: cool. plan: 1) pin prod routing to prev999 (done), 2) update release notes + jira RR-462, 3) schedule resign-republish once mirrors finish, 4) unpause only when deploybot sees all quarantines cleared.
tom: running pinback: ```
./release-tools pinback --release=3.12.1 --digest=sha256:prev999 --scope=prod --note="paused: eu manifest conflicts"
```
ci-bot: pinback succeeded, prod routing pinned to sha256:prev999
anya: I've updated the release tracker and customer-facing notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RR-462. Added note about temporary pause and expected 45m window.
luca: after resign/republish we should add a post-rollout check to ensure no digest drift across regions.
anya: agree. Also add a deploybot guard: do not auto-unpause unless s3 artifact list shows no quarantined items and ops-bot reports all-signatures-eu-04.
deploybot: watch rule created: resume-on = quarantines == 0 AND signature_state == all-eu-04
tom: thanks. I'll follow up with a short incident blurb after resolution. :thumbsup:
